fix: Remove the key material from the document. Keep the finding text and put the words [redacted, referenced by broker handle] where the key was. This check catches a PEM or OpenSSH private key header of any type, a line that holds nothing but 64 or more hex characters (the shape of a raw ed25519 seed), and 64 hex characters on a line that also carries the word seed, secret or private. It deliberately ignores a hash written with other text on its line, which is how this system prints every sha256, so a bare seed pasted mid-sentence with no label reads as a hash and gets past it; do not treat a pass as proof that a document carrying inline hex is clean.
